title: FLEXITOKENS: Flexible Tokenization for Evolving Language Models
desc: We propose a flexible tokenization framework that allows language models to adapt their tokenization strategy during training and inference, enabling better handling of evolving vocabularies and multilingual text.

title: Continually Adding New Languages to Multilingual Language Models
desc: We propose LayRA (Layer-Selective LoRA), which adds new languages and instruction-tuning to pre-trained multilingual models by applying low-rank adapters only to the initial and final layers — preserving existing language capabilities while efficiently learning new ones.

title: AfriMed-QA: A Pan-African, Multi-Specialty, Medical Question-Answering Benchmark Dataset
desc: A pan-African medical QA benchmark evaluating large language models on medical knowledge across African healthcare contexts. Joint work with partners from Google, PATH, Intron, and Sinsoke.

title: Bloom Library: Multimodal Datasets in 300+ Languages for a Variety of Downstream Tasks
desc: A linguistically diverse collection of multimodal and multilingual datasets covering 363 languages across 32 language families — among the most multilingual datasets for language modeling, image captioning, and speech.
